answer: A synchronous wharf roll-call check stops bulk fake agents. Each applicant stakes 40 units for one slot and presents orchard work echoing a nonce issued at that slot, proving live presence. The k-th fake costs 40 plus 3k units, as extra operators cost more with n; stakes lock to one slot, cannot be reused, verifiers enforce forfeiture, and failure loses stake and slot. One fake costs 43; 1,000 cost 1,541,500 units. A device farm fails: one operator cannot attend two slots at once, and a recorded echo misses the fresh nonce. Honest agents attend once and keep earnings.
